 Stoke City v Birmingham City confirmed lineups and team news
 Matt Gibbs
 Published: 1 hour ago
 Stoke City take on league leaders Birmingham City in the Championship this afternoon. 
 The Potters start the weekend third in the Championship table following their 2-1 win at Portsmouth before the international break.
Mark Robins' side are level on points with the Blues, who arrive at the bet365 Stadium in excellent form.
The visitors have won each of their last three matches to propel themselves to the top of the table.
